submit_slurm_jobs: submit a batch of parallel jobs to SLURM using submitit with custom resource parameters
wait_for_jobs: wait for all submitted SLURM jobs to complete execution before continuing
get_slurm_config: extract and prepare SLURM configuration parameters for a specific FastCSP module and executor type
get_genarris_slurm_config: get SLURM configuration parameters for the genarris structure generation module
get_relax_slurm_config: get SLURM configuration parameters for the relax structure optimization module
